fusions.name: Belfry Stroke
fusions.desc: Strikes your own plate so it rings, dealing 12 resonating damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Latching Weight
fusions.desc: A hooked weapon strike that deals 8 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, slows it by 20% for 3 seconds, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Answering Peal
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, 30% of the damage you take echoes back to whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Dark-Hung Mail
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 12%.
